_comment: The lab's routing: which notices become a task, for which assignment group, at which severity, and which only go in the weekly digest. Every team name here is fictional (contoso.example). An agency writes its own from templates/routing.template.json, at work, and keeps it inside its boundary. Rules are tried in order; the first whose every 'match' key matches wins. A notice no rule matches takes 'defaults'. Severities and response windows are the Ticket-to-Machine finding contract's (P1 immediate, P2 1 hour, P3 24 hours, P4 72 hours; program design, not a federal requirement).

rules.name: Security advisories go to security operations
Open incidents that name our resources
Open Microsoft 365 incidents (tenant-wide; service health names no resources)
Anything else the provider says needs action
Microsoft 365 stay-informed posts for a service the lab doesn't use
